blurb: Enjoy staying in a beautiful pine woods with the touch of an ocean breeze. Whether you rent a cottage, pitch a tent, or bring your trailer, Maurice’s offers the total Cape Cod Nature experience. Maurice’s is nestled next to the National Seashore. Crystal clear ponds and world renowned bay and ocean beaches are minutes away.
